# USAFacts

> > USAFacts provides nonpartisan government data and statistics on US demographics, population trends, and the State of the Union.

USAFacts aggregates data from the US Census Bureau's Population Estimates Program and other federal sources to deliver accessible insights on population growth, migration patterns, and standard of living across states and counties. The site serves as a comprehensive resource for understanding demographic change and government statistics across America.

## Key Topics

- US Census Bureau data
- Population Estimates Program
- Demographic trends
- Population growth and decline
- Domestic migration patterns
- Immigration patterns
- Natural population change
- County-level statistics
- State demographics
- Census data analysis
- Age demographics
- Migration trends
- Standard of living metrics
- State of the Union reporting

## State of the Union & National Reports

- [US Standard of Living Fact Sheet: State of the Union 2026](https://usafacts.org/reports/state-of-the-union/standard-of-living): State of the Union 2026 report: GDP, household debt, poverty statistics
- [The Viz Lab](https://usafacts.org/the-viz-lab): The Viz Lab: data visualization experiments with government data charts

## State Population Statistics

- [How many people live in Colorado?](https://usafacts.org/answers/how-many-people-live-in-the-us/state/colorado): Colorado population statistics: 6.01M people, 20th-most populous state
- [How many people live in Maine?](https://usafacts.org/answers/how-many-people-live-in-the-us/state/maine): Maine population statistics: 1.41M people, 42nd-most populous state

## County Population Growth Trends

- [Is York County, SC's population growing or shrinking?](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/york-county-sc): York County, SC population growth: +4,600 people via domestic migration
- [Is Union County, OH's population growing or shrinking?](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/union-county-oh): Union County, OH population growth: +2,000 people via domestic migration
- [Is Suwannee County, FL's population growing or shrinking?](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/suwannee-county-fl): Suwannee County, FL population growth: +1,400 people, 3% annually
- [Is Sullivan County, TN's population growing or shrinking?](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/sullivan-county-tn): Sullivan County, TN population growth: +649 people, 0.4% increase
- [Is Webster County, MO's population growing or shrinking?](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/webster-county-mo): Webster County, MO population growth: +560 people, 1.4% annually

## County Population Decline Trends

- [Is Tuscola County, MI's population growing or shrinking?](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/tuscola-county-mi): Tuscola County, MI population decline: deaths outpacing births, -99 people
- [Is Yellow Medicine County, MN's population growing or shrinking?](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/yellow-medicine-county-mn): Yellow Medicine County, MN population decline: -98 people, -1% annually
- [Is Wilkin County, MN's population growing or shrinking?](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/wilkin-county-mn): Wilkin County, MN population decline: -62 people, deaths outpacing births
- [Is Worth County, MO's population growing or shrinking?](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/worth-county-mo): Worth County, MO population decline data: -31 people, -1.6% annually
- [Is Wallace County, KS's population growing or shrinking?](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/wallace-county-ks): Wallace County, KS population decline: -29 people, -1.9% annually
